title: Official businesses
intro: Discover platform-onboarded dealers and brands. Beirut Time is a marketplace; it does not sell or service watches.
empty: No official businesses are available yet.
unavailable: This service is temporarily unavailable. No change has been confirmed.
forbidden: Your current account does not have permission for this action.
stale: This record changed. Reload it before trying again.
saved: The current record has been saved.
noMembers: No authorized colleagues are recorded for this business.
operatorOnly: Only an authorized operator can issue business access. There is no public dealer or brand application.
contactIntro: Only verified recipients can receive private notices. A proposed change never replaces your current verified delivery contact until proof succeeds.
passwordIncorrect: Confirm your current password and try again.
invalidContact: Check the contact format and required fields.
checkFields: Check the supplied fields and try again.
unsupportedCapability: The selected business does not support that capability.
applicantUnavailable: An active applicant is required before approval.
evidenceIncomplete: Complete identity and possession evidence is required before approval.
sampleDelivery: Sample contact-delivery simulator — not a sent message
pendingDelivery: Delivery is pending. Check your recipient once delivery completes.
verification_failed: The code could not be verified. It may be expired or already used.
verification_limited: Too many requests. Wait before requesting another code.
reviewIntro: Review a person’s identity and possession evidence. This is not physical watch authentication and never grants business privileges.
noReviews: No private applications are assigned to you.
sampleInput: This is labeled sample business content
grantHelp: Privileges are exact and organization-scoped. A matching job title in another business grants nothing.
reviewHelp: Only the current assigned reviewer can inspect private proof. Assignment changes immediately remove the former reviewer’s access.
